operating_notes.text: BESS expansion planned from 2.5 GWh to 5 GWh along with 600 units/annum container manufacturing capacity.
Secured ₹1,128 Cr contract to develop a 1 GWh BESS at NTPC's Barauni Thermal Power Station in Bihar.
Gross preferential proceeds revised to ₹292.58 Cr due to equity under-subscription.
Secured ₹165.41 Cr order from RRVPNL for 400 kV Grid Sub-Station at Dahra, Kota, to be executed in 18 months.
Order book at 31 March 2026 was ₹5,369 Cr: ₹1,369 Cr legacy and ₹4,000 Cr new orders, with new orders guided at 10-12% margins over 3-4 years.
NTPC BESS order of ₹1,128 Cr (250 MW / 1,000 MWh) ties up ~40% of Phase 1 2.5 GWh capacity, targeted Q1FY27.
NARCL-covered debt of ₹700 Cr: ₹320 Cr repaid, ₹380 Cr outstanding, backed by a ₹627 Cr arbitration award; claims filed total ₹4,526 Cr.
BESS 2.5 GW manufacturing facility at Pune targeted to commence in June 2026.

timeline.summary: Allotted 42,44,844 equity shares at ₹215 per share on preferential basis upon exercise of warrants by promoter group and public holders.
SPML Infra shareholders passed postal ballot resolutions approving related party transactions with JWIL Infra Ltd and nominee director remuneration.
SPML Infra secured a ₹1,128 Cr 1 GWh Battery Energy Storage System contract from NTPC on May 6, 2026.
SPML Infra filed its Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹210.43 Cr utilization out of ₹292.58 Cr revised proceeds.
SPML Infra's EGM on May 16, 2026, approved preferential share and warrant issues and debt conversion for NARCL.
SPML Infra secured a ₹165.41 crore order from RRVPNL to build a 400 kV grid sub-station at Kota, Rajasthan.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹290.51 Cr, net profit ₹27.18 Cr.
SPML Infra's 4QFY26 investor presentation showed a ₹5,369 Cr order book at 31 March 2026 (₹4,000 Cr new orders), guided 10-12% margins on new orders, and an ICRA BBB- (Stable) rating.
SPML Infra Limited hosted Q4 & FY2026-27 earnings conference call on June 1, 2026, with audio recording available via provided link.
SPML Infra hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹293.9 Cr and guiding for >25% growth in FY27.
